description: Create a fan-out: 1-30 seats (RESEARCH by default, or LOCAL subagent seats) plus one synthesizer under ONE cycle root (POST /coord/fanouts). No Decision cards, Parked cards or pages per seat: only a control action or the closing roll-up reaches a human. Needs an API key with agent:dispatch:code (an admin session has no dispatch budget: key_required). dry_run true runs the same validation and ceiling/cap pre-check and returns dry_run, plan_sha256, seats and problems without spending budget or creating anything. Otherwise it consumes seats + 1 dispatch units BEFORE the create; a refusal only the database can see (cap_below_plan, fanout_open_limit, bad agent_id, reserve_floor_unset) still consumes them, by design. Fails fanout_ceiling_unset until the owner sets a ceiling, over_ceiling when cap exceeds it. idempotency_key replays a duplicate within 24h on the same plan, else idempotency_body_mismatch. Every seat, the synth and the roll-up leave a signed completion. Track with tascan_get_fanout.

breaker_k.description: Paid (non-infrastructure) seat failures before the breaker pauses the fan-out (2-5, default 2). An expired run never counts.

canary.description: How many seats release immediately; the rest stay held on T_F until the first canary settles done. Default min(2, seats.length).

cap.description: This fan-out's total micro-USD budget, synth reserve included. Refused over_ceiling if it exceeds the org's fan-out spending ceiling.

deadline_min.description: Minutes before an idle seat is dropped and the barrier re-evaluated, and before a stuck synthesizing fan-out closes deadline (10-1440, default 240).

dry_run.description: true runs the same validation plus the ceiling/cap pre-check and returns {dry_run:true, plan_sha256, seats, problems:[]} WITHOUT consuming budget or creating a fan-out -- a real preflight, not a real create.

idempotency_key.description: Optional replay key (<= 200 chars). The same key within 24h on the same plan returns duplicate:true with the existing fanout_id; on a different plan it is refused idempotency_body_mismatch.

min_ok.description: Minimum seats that must finish done before the synth barrier can close. Default ceil(seats.length / 2).

project_id.description: Working project (UUID). The fan-out root T_F is minted on its Questions list (coord_ensure_lists).

seat_defaults.description: Shared defaults applied when a seat names no brief of its own.

brief.description: Default seat prompt (1-40000 chars), used by any seat that names no brief of its own.

est_micro_usd.description: Positive integer micro-USD estimate per seat, used by the RPC's cap_below_plan check.

review_est_micro_usd.description: Non-negative integer micro-USD estimate per seat review. Must be > 0 when seat_review is per_seat.

seat_review.description: per_seat mints one review per seat (allowed for at most 10 seats); none skips seat review. Default per_seat for <=10 seats, none above that.

seats.description: 1-30 seats. Each names the agent that runs it; brief/role fall back to seat_defaults when omitted.

agent_id.description: A registered agent_registry id in this org, matching ^[a-z][a-z0-9-]{0,39}$. Never a system-* worker.

brief.description: This seat's own prompt (1-40000 chars). Falls back to seat_defaults.brief when omitted -- one of the two is required.

role.description: Optional label for this seat (1-100 chars), e.g. "topic A".

runner.description: Default "research" (the cloud runner claims it). "local" names a registered local/subagent agent_id -- only that agent, claiming as itself (tascan_claim_run instance starting with "<agent_id>:"), can claim the seat; it is never webhook-fired.

synth.description: The synthesizer that runs once the barrier closes, reading every done seat's stored output as DATA.

max_cost_micro_usd.description: Positive integer micro-USD reserved for the synth run; reserved out of cap up front, released back into the seat budget only at barrier close.

title.description: Short human title (1-200 chars). T_F becomes "FANOUT: <title>"; seats become "RESEARCH: [seat-NN] <title>"; the synth becomes "RESEARCH: [synth] <title>".

name: tascan_create_fanout
